name: maid-cafe-programming-school
description: Ask your local aruaru-llm AI teacher, grounded by aruaru-search (unlimited, key-free) + optional GitHub investigation, right from VS Code — the companion extension to open-english. Optionally incorporate your own paid Claude subscription.

commands.title: Maid Cafe School: Open Menu / メニューを開く
Maid Cafe School: Ask the AI Teacher / AI先生に質問する
Maid Cafe School: Toggle "Study While Developing" / 「同時にプログラムの学習も行なう」の切替
Maid Cafe School: Incorporate My Paid Claude / 有料版のClaudeを組み込む
Maid Cafe School: Choose AI Teacher (aruaru-llm/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Grok/Claude) / AI先生を選択
Maid Cafe School: Toggle "Speak Text" / 「テキスト内容をしゃべる」の切替
Maid Cafe School: Keyboard Typing Corner / キーボードタイピングコーナー
Maid Cafe School: Programming Basics (kid-friendly) / プログラミング基礎教室
Maid Cafe School: JavaScript Classroom / JavaScript教室
Maid Cafe School: Today's Sample Task (from aruaru-jobs) / 今日のサンプル案件
Maid Cafe School: Learn Japanese/English/World Languages / 日本語・英語・世界の言語を学ぶ
Maid Cafe School: Set Up Related Repos / 関連リポジトリのセットアップ
Maid Cafe School: Toggle Study BGM (archive.org, commercial-safe) / 学習中BGMの切替(archive.org、商用利用可)
Maid Cafe School: Generate & Play Study BGM Now / 学習中BGMを今すぐ生成・再生

maidCafeSchool.aruaruLlmBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your locally running aruaru-llm instance. / お使いのaruaru-llmの接続先URL。

maidCafeSchool.studyWhileDeveloping.description: Also ask the AI teacher to explain relevant basics while developing (mirrors open-english's checkbox). / 開発を進めながら関連する基礎知識も教えてもらう(open-englishのチェックボックスと同じ)。

maidCafeSchool.useGithubInvestigation.description: Ground answers with a GitHub investigation in addition to aruaru-search's unlimited search. / aruaru-searchの無制限検索に加えてGitHub調査でも回答を裏付ける。

maidCafeSchool.speakText.description: Speak the greeting and the AI teacher's replies aloud (default ON; your choice is remembered in VS Code settings). / 出迎えの挨拶とAI先生の回答をしゃべる(既定ON、チェックの状態はVS Codeの設定に記憶されます)。

maidCafeSchool.aruaruJobsBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the aruaru-jobs freelance job search site, used by "Today's Sample Task". / 「今日のサンプル案件」機能が使うaruaru-jobsの接続先URL。

maidCafeSchool.studyBgm.enabled.description: Stream study BGM from archive.org (via aruaru-search, Public Domain/CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA only — commercial use allowed, but CC-BY/CC-BY-SA legally require attribution). / archive.orgから学習中BGMをストリーミングする(aruaru-search経由、パブリックドメイン/CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SAのみ——商用利用可、ただしCC-BY/CC-BY-SAは表示義務あり)。

maidCafeSchool.studyBgm.prompt.description: Search terms for the archive.org BGM search (song/performer/composer keywords). / archive.org BGM検索の検索語(曲名/演奏者/作曲者のキーワード)。
